entries.title: The mod is an overlay on --ax-screen-reader, not a replacement
entries.body: The screen reader mode already renders static spinners, a flat labelled transcript, numbered menus and a terminal bell. Replacing the Spinner was dropped from scope as redundant. Before adding any feature, check what the mode already does with the screen reader actually running; the open issues do not always say whether the reporter had the mode on (AskUserQuestion, #88839, is the first case to verify).

entries.title: Screen reader mode cannot be switched on inside a running session
entries.body: The mode is decided once at startup (flag, then CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER, then the axScreenReader setting) and mods load after that decision. There is no /config row, so $.config.set cannot change it. A mod can only write axScreenReader: true to ~/.claude/settings.json for the next session and announce the restart by speech and bell. Verified in the 2.1.295 binary; source: docs/research/rozpoznanie-2026-10-09.md section 5.

entries.title: Install instructions must avoid in-session pickers
entries.body: /plugin install opens a picker that does not work with NVDA. Documentation must give the shell path: claude plugin install <name>@<marketplace> --scope user, then start claude normally. The same applies to any onboarding step the mod designs.

entries.title: Keep mod API behind a thin adapter so logic is testable without Claude Code
entries.body: Detection, mode-state resolution, settings writing and the consent state machine take injected run/fs/env/store/clock interfaces and return actions; src/adapter.ts is the only module that calls $.process, $.fs, $.store, $.audio and $.ui. Vitest then covers the decisions without launching Claude Code, and manual sessions with VoiceOver and NVDA only verify the adapter and the ear. Decided in docs/plans/screen-reader-detection-plan.md.
